sources.entry: CubicBezier - CubicBezier Generator for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/isaced/CubicBezier) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cubicbezier/id1228492117?platform=mac)

summary.one_liner: A macOS desktop widget for generating cubic Bezier easing curves by dragging control points and previewing the animation.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes CubicBezier as a Bezier curve generator widget for macOS, inspired by cubic-bezier.com. Users drag small dots to adjust the curve's parameters. An animation preview lets them compare curves visually. The README says the tool is meant to make writing animations easier. It names two output formats: CSS cubic-bezier() and iOS/macOS CAMediaTimingFunction. The README is short and gives no further detail on features or internals.
use_cases: Designing CSS easing curves for transitions
Choosing timing functions for iOS or macOS Core Animation
Previewing and comparing animation easing curves
Tuning animation timing by dragging control points
how_to_run: Download the app from the GitHub release page, or from the App Store listing linked in the awesome-mac entry.
stack: Swift (inferred from the README's Apple-platform focus; not stated explicitly)
notable: Drag-to-adjust control points with live animation preview
Available on the App Store and as a GitHub release download
caveats: README is brief and does not describe build steps or detailed features
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac entry, with the App Store version linked
